entries.55c2460a25ccde3b: Cyclodextrin is a cyclic oligosaccharide. Production started at the Osaka plant in 1983.
entries.5a654a1dd377b9e0: A business that manufactures and sells sugar. Manufacturing is carried out by commissioning processing from affiliates Taiheiyo Seito Co., Ltd., Kansai Seito Co., Ltd. and Narumiya Co., Ltd., and sales are mainly handled by consolidated subsidiary Pearl Ace Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥31,296 million.
entries.857acfbb8bd64326: A sugar company founded in Taiwan that centers on manufacturing and selling refined sugar and also handles functional materials such as lactosucrose oligosaccharide.
entries.8b5cd4a42a570a3d: A business that manufactures and sells lactose-fructose oligosaccharides and cyclodextrin. Manufacturing is commissioned to Kansai Seito Co., Ltd., and Pearl Ace Co., Ltd. sells the products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,562 million.
entries.e3bff1280d59f8ac: The 'Oligo no Okage' series, whose main ingredient is lactose-fructose oligosaccharides, and 'Beets no Okage', which combines beets with lactose-fructose oligosaccharides. The 'Oligo no Okage' series has obtained approval to carry the Foods for Specified Health Uses label.
